scope: Source selection for Electron45.1.0 / Chromium156.0.8078.49, Linux x64 and Windows x64 GN builds. Does not claim the standalone upstream libaddressinput build is fully mirrored.

gitlinks.reason: The exact Chromium BUILD.gn imports //tools/grit/grit_rule.gni and builds its own strings target from Chromium resource inputs. The 261 logical entries under src/tools/grit are retained in the full, verified Chromium source archive, rather than using libaddressinput externals/grit.

The util target compiles Chromium chromium/json.cc instead of upstream cpp/src/util/json.cc. The Chromium implementation uses base::JSONReader; the upstream file that includes rapidjson/document.h is not in the GN source list.

provenance: The two gitlink pins are preserved in the reconstructed Git-tree proof. Their empty directories in the repository archive are not represented as included submodule source code.
